full_details: In the morning the loaf was still shrunk on the pan. You read a Rose bill at the lodging, title only, and you did not go. At two the Theatre played the comedy to the biggest yard since Easter Monday, more apprentices than sweethearts, loud before the play and in it. Kemp fed them. Garnish stopped counting at fifteen. The hush at the messenger came late and broke early. Afterwards Margery emptied her box without her usual line. She said the apprentices were thick as flies, and that they laughed like men who mean to laugh at something else after. Burbage shrugged it off. You did not. Kemp danced the jig of the slippers, and the yard would not let him go. At night you kept her sentence. You did not open the king.
one_sentence: You played the comedy to a loud Whit Monday yard, and afterwards you kept what Margery said.
title: Garnish's fifteen, and Margery's yard
